name: Prio S.A.
summary: PRIO S.A. operates as a holding company, primarily dedicated to the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas, executing these activities through its diverse range of subsidiaries. The firm also holds equity stakes and maintains partnership roles in other businesses, both within Brazil and across global markets. Its portfolio of significant energy developments encompasses the Polvo, Tubarão Martelo, Frade, Wahoo, Albacora Leste, and Peregrino Fields. Marcio Rocha Mello established the company on October 13, 2008, and its principal offices are located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
